{{Quote|Shortwave remote control hack. Range&mdash;less than a klick. It's low-grade tech, and a quick build, too. This was most likely constructed on-world.|[[Cody/Legends|Cody]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
The '''shortwave remote control hack''' was a short-range control unit used by [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] used this device in an attempt to [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|disrupt]] the [[Goldskin Parade]]. The device allowed Gorga to remotely take control of a [[Separatist Heavy Speeder]] which was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]].
